title: Bermuda Sunset | Scenic Stays
meta_description: This home boasts four bedrooms and four and a half baths and sleeps eight to ten guests. This home is situated on the serene Santa Rosa Sound in Navarre Beach. Bermuda Sunset is located within the quiet gated community of Caribbean Isle with amenities such as a community pool and tennis court.
description_expanded: This home boasts four bedrooms and four and a half baths and sleeps eight to ten guests. This home is situated on the serene Santa Rosa Sound in Navarre Beach. Bermuda Sunset is located within the quiet gated community of Caribbean Isle with amenities such as a community pool and tennis court. Bermuda Sunset is tastefully furnished with coastal flair and high end finishes and appliances. Each bedroom has its own designated full bath and smart TV. On the main living floor (located on the 2nd floor), a queen suite sleeps two with views of the Sound and surrounding neighborhood. The open concept, fully appointed kitchen, living, and dining area features sweeping views of the Sound that open to an outdoor patio with plenty of seating for guests. The dining area is surrounded on three sides by large windows that overlook the water, which let in an abundance of natural light. You can enjoy delicious meals and take in the relaxing views, and there is an oversized island with additional seating. The front balcony off the main living area offers seating for four with great views of the sunset and the beautiful Caribbean Isle neighborhood. The third floor includes three bedrooms each with full baths. The primary suite has a king size bed and its own private balcony with rocking chairs and a hammock for relaxing. The primary closet is a walk-in with plenty of storage. The en suite bath is a spa-like retreat that includes a large rain shower and separate soaking tub. The second bedroom is a king suite which sleeps two. The third bedroom is a bunk room that can sleep up to four. All of the bedrooms on the third level have beautiful views of the water and neighborhood. Bermuda Sunset also offers a convenient laundry area on this level containing a washer and dryer. The garage is equipped with three kayaks and safety vests. There is also a propane grill for grilling on the outdoor patio only steps away from the sand, as well as a small beverage fridge so you don’t even have to walk up the stairs for your cold juice box or beer. There is plenty of outdoor seating on the ground level so you can enjoy the views. There is also a half bath located in the garage, as well as an outdoor shower. It is recommended that shoes be work when walking to the Pier as there may be sand spurs/stickers etc. To top off your vacation experience, enjoy sitting at the end of your own private pier that stretches 200 feet into the Sound for fishing, spending time with family, watching the dolphins and pelicans, or simply taking in the beautiful Navarre sunsets. Make sure to bring your fishing poles and tackle box. The Santa Rosa Sound is perfect for wading, swimming, and kayaking. Unlike the Gulf of Mexico, the Sound is a much calmer body of water with no undertow for family fun! And the emerald green waters of the Gulf are just a short five to ten minute walk. If you prefer to drive, there are public beach access parking lots very close to the Caribbean Isle subdivision. You will find lots of fun activities nearby when you are ready for a break from the beach. Treat the kids to ice cream and snowballs close by. Visit the Gulf Breeze Zoo, the Navarre Beach Fishing Pier, the longest fishing pier in Florida, the Navarre Beach Sea Turtle Conservation Center, or spend time at the splash pad or the inflatable playground right across the bridge. Because this home is located in a private community with permanent residents, all guests must be respectful of the neighbors and are required to follow all rules of the community, including parking, noise, trash, pool use, etc. Bermuda Sunset has parking for four vehicles in the driveway - parking on the street is not allowed per community rules. There is no parking in the garage. Per strict community rules, No Boats, No Trailers, or RV parking on the property. Additionally, tying up boats, jet skis or any other watercraft to the pier is strictly prohibited. TRASH MUST BE PLACED AT THE ROAD FRIDAY AFTERNOON FOR PICK UP SATURDAY MORNING Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden, and pets are unfortunately not welcome and subject to immediate departure if found to be inhabiting a property. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund.
